name: Primadonna
text:
Frequency once per hour

---
The spotlight should always be on you and you alone. Attempt a Performance check check against the Will DCs of all enemies within 30 feet who can see or hear you. On a success, the targets focus on you and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to hit you, but they're Off-Guard to all creatures other than yourself. On a critical success, the effect lasts for 3 rounds.
